integrity: The proof reduces adjacency to union of whole-coordinate supports in the Artinian local decomposition. Exhaustive finite calculations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite commutative Artinian rings that are not local.
No extension to noncommutative or non-Artinian co-maximal ideal graphs is claimed.
The ordinary-domination lower bound for three or more factors is taken from published literature; the total and paired upper constructions and parity lower bound are proved directly.
title: Total and paired domination of co-maximal ideal graphs of Artinian rings
